## YAML: Optionen in der `_quarto.yml`

### Projekt

```{.yaml}
project:
  type: website       # website | book | manuscript | default
  output-dir: docs    # wohin die gebauten Dateien kommen
```

### Ausführen (Vorgaben für allen Code)

```{.yaml}
execute:
  echo: true          # Quellcode zeigen
  eval: true          # Code ausführen
  warning: false      # Warnungen ausblenden
  error: false        # bei Fehlern abbrechen
  freeze: auto        # auto | true | false
```

### Format

```{.yaml}
format:
  html:
    toc: true
    toc-depth: 3
    theme:              # ein Name (theme: cosmo) oder eine Liste
      - cosmo
      - custom.scss
    code-fold: true
    code-tools: true
    number-sections: false
  pdf:
    toc: true
    documentclass: article
    geometry: margin=2.5cm
  docx:
    toc: true
```

### Website

```{.yaml}
website:
  title: "Meine Seite"
  navbar:
    left:
      - text: "Start"
        href: index.qmd
      - text: "Extern"
        href: https://example.com
    right:
      - icon: github
        href: https://github.com/your/repo
  sidebar:
    - id: my-sidebar
      style: docked        # docked | floating
      contents:
        - href: page.qmd
          text: Titel der Seite
        - section: "Gruppe"
          contents:
            - href: sub.qmd
              text: Unterseite
```

### Profile

```{.yaml}
profile:
  default: [web, deutsch]
  group:
    - [web, print]          # aus jeder Gruppe ist genau eines aktiv
    - [deutsch, english]
```

```{.bash}
quarto render --profile print,english
```

## QMD: Optionen für Codeblöcke

```{.yaml}
#| echo: false          # Quellcode ausblenden
#| eval: false          # nicht ausführen (nur Code zeigen)
#| output: false        # Ausgabe ausblenden
#| warning: false       # Warnungen ausblenden
#| include: false       # alles ausblenden (Code läuft trotzdem)
#| code-fold: true      # true | false: Code einklappbar
#| code-summary: "Code zeigen"
#| fig-cap: "Meine Abbildung"
#| fig-align: center    # left | center | right
#| label: fig-myplot    # für Querverweise
```

### Kennungen für Querverweise

| Art | Beginn der Kennung | Verweis |
|---|---|---|
| Abbildung | `fig-` | `@fig-myplot` |
| Tabelle | `tbl-` | `@tbl-mydata` |
| Abschnitt | `sec-` (an der Überschrift) | `@sec-intro` |

---

## QMD: bedingte Inhalte

```{.markdown}
::: {.content-visible when-profile="deutsch"}
Nur auf Deutsch sichtbar.
:::

::: {.content-hidden when-format="pdf"}
Nicht im PDF.
:::
```

## QMD: Markdown-Elemente

### Callouts

```{.markdown}
::: {.callout-note}
::: {.callout-tip}
::: {.callout-warning}
::: {.callout-important}
::: {.callout-caution}

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Titel
Anfangs verborgen.
:::
```

### Shortcodes

```{.markdown}
{{</* include other-file.qmd */>}}   ← andere Datei einbetten
{{</* pagebreak */>}}                ← Seitenumbruch erzwingen (PDF)
{{</* kbd Ctrl+C */>}}               ← Tastenkürzel darstellen
```

### Raster

```{.markdown}
::: {.grid}
::: {.g-col-6}
Linke Spalte (halbe Breite)
:::
::: {.g-col-6}
Rechte Spalte (halbe Breite)
:::
:::
```

Spaltenbreiten werden in Zwölfteln angegeben: `g-col-4` ist ein Drittel, `g-col-6` die Hälfte, `g-col-12` die ganze Breite.

## Extensions: Schreibweisen im Überblick

```{.bash}
quarto add parmsam/quizdown
quarto add Erasmus-CTM/pyodide-interaktiv
quarto add Erasmus-CTM/py-exercise
quarto add Erasmus-CTM/math-exercise      # bringt jsxgraph mit
```

```{.yaml}
filters:                 # Reihenfolge beachten
  - parmsam/quizdown
  - Erasmus-CTM/pyodide-interaktiv
  - Erasmus-CTM/py-exercise
  - jsxgraph
  - Erasmus-CTM/math-exercise
```

### quizdown

````{.markdown}
```{quizdown}
---
locale: de
---
# Fragetext?
1. [x] Richtige Antwort
1. [ ] Falsche Antwort
```
````

### pyodide-interaktiv

````{.markdown}
```{pyodide-python}
#| autorun: false
#| read-only: false
#| code-fold: false
#| context: interactive   # interactive | output | setup
print("läuft im Browser")
```
````

Alle Zellen einer Seite teilen sich ihre Variablen. `plt.show()` löst die Ausgabe von Plots und Animationen aus.

### py-exercise

````{.markdown}
```{py-exercise}
#| caption: Titel
#| forbidden-keywords: for, while
def my_func(x):
    pass        # hier tragen Studierende die Lösung ein

## TESTS ##
assert my_func(2) == 4, "Rückmeldung bei Fehler"
```
````

### math-exercise

````{.markdown}
```{math-exercise}
#| label: kreis
#| vars: r
#| mode: equivalent
Flächeninhalt eines Kreises mit r = 3: _[pi*9]
```
````

| Feld | Bedeutung |
|---|---|
| `_[a]` / `__[a]` / `___[a]` | schmal / mittel / breit |
| `vec[a,b,c]` | Vektor |
| `mat[a,b;c,d]` | Matrix (Komma: Spalte, Strichpunkt: Zeile) |

| `mode` | Prüft |
|---|---|
| `equivalent` | mathematisch gleichwertig (Standard), mit `reject` und `form` |
| `exact` | genau diese Darstellung |
| `numeric` | Zahlenwert, mit `tolerance`, `decplaces` oder `sigfigs` |
| `string` / `string_ci` | Text wörtlich / ohne Groß- und Kleinschreibung |
| `set` | Liste ohne Reihenfolge |
| `custom` | eigener Prüfcode in `checker` |

Weitere Optionen: `pool: true`, `partial-credit: true`, `field-labels`, `context`.

### JSXGraph

````{.markdown}
```jsxgraph
var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(BOARDID, {
    boundingbox: [-5, 5, 5, -5], axis: true
});
board.create('functiongraph', [Math.sin]);
```
````

Als Antwort auf eine Aufgabe: Block mit `{.jsxgraph assessment_id="brett"}` und `JXG.QuartoAssessment.register(...)`, in der Aufgabe `#| mode: custom` und `#| response: jsxgraph:brett`.

## CSS: Hilfsklassen von Bootstrap

| Klasse | Wirkung |
|---|---|
| `.text-center` | Text zentrieren |
| `.text-muted` | grauer Text |
| `.text-white` | weißer Text |
| `.fw-bold` | fett |
| `.border` | Rahmen |
| `.rounded` | runde Ecken |
| `.shadow` | Schatten |
| `.bg-light` | heller Hintergrund |
| `.bg-primary` | Hintergrund in der Hauptfarbe |
| `.p-{0-5}` | Innenabstand auf allen Seiten |
| `.m-{0-5}` | Außenabstand auf allen Seiten |
| `.mt-{0-5}` / `.mb-{0-5}` | Abstand nach oben / unten |
| `.d-flex` | Flexbox-Behälter |
| `.gap-{0-5}` | Abstand zwischen Flex-Elementen |
| `.justify-content-center` | Flex-Elemente zentrieren |

## QMD: code chunk options

```{.yaml}
#| echo: false          # hide source code
#| eval: false          # don't run (show code only)
#| output: false        # hide output
#| warning: false       # hide warnings
#| include: false       # hide everything (the code still runs)
#| code-fold: true      # true | false: collapsible code block
#| code-summary: "Show the code"
#| fig-cap: "My figure"
#| fig-align: center    # left | center | right
#| label: fig-myplot    # for cross-referencing
```

### Cross-reference labels

| Type | Label prefix | Reference |
|---|---|---|
| Figure | `fig-` | `@fig-myplot` |
| Table | `tbl-` | `@tbl-mydata` |
| Section | `sec-` (on heading) | `@sec-intro` |

## QMD: Markdown elements

### Callouts

```{.markdown}
::: {.callout-note}
::: {.callout-tip}
::: {.callout-warning}
::: {.callout-important}
::: {.callout-caution}

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Title
Hidden by default.
:::
```

### Shortcodes

```{.markdown}
{{</* include other-file.qmd */>}}   ← embed another file
{{</* pagebreak */>}}                ← force page break (PDF)
{{</* kbd Ctrl+C */>}}               ← keyboard shortcut styling
```

### Grid layout

```{.markdown}
::: {.grid}
::: {.g-col-6}
Left column (half width)
:::
::: {.g-col-6}
Right column (half width)
:::
:::
```

Column widths are in 12ths: `g-col-4` = one third, `g-col-6` = half, `g-col-12` = full.

## Extensions: syntax summary

```{.bash}
quarto add parmsam/quizdown
quarto add Erasmus-CTM/pyodide-interaktiv
quarto add Erasmus-CTM/py-exercise
quarto add Erasmus-CTM/math-exercise      # brings jsxgraph along
```

```{.yaml}
filters:                 # mind the order
  - parmsam/quizdown
  - Erasmus-CTM/pyodide-interaktiv
  - Erasmus-CTM/py-exercise
  - jsxgraph
  - Erasmus-CTM/math-exercise
```

### quizdown

````{.markdown}
```{quizdown}
---
locale: en
---
# Question text?
1. [x] Correct answer
1. [ ] Wrong answer
```
````

### pyodide-interaktiv

````{.markdown}
```{pyodide-python}
#| autorun: false
#| read-only: false
#| code-fold: false
#| context: interactive   # interactive | output | setup
print("runs in browser")
```
````

All cells on a page share their variables. `plt.show()` triggers the output of plots and animations.

### py-exercise

````{.markdown}
```{py-exercise}
#| caption: Title
#| forbidden-keywords: for, while
def my_func(x):
    pass        # student fills this in

## TESTS ##
assert my_func(2) == 4, "Feedback on failure"
```
````

### math-exercise

````{.markdown}
```{math-exercise}
#| label: circle
#| vars: r
#| mode: equivalent
Area of a circle with r = 3: _[pi*9]
```
````

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `_[a]` / `__[a]` / `___[a]` | narrow / medium / wide |
| `vec[a,b,c]` | vector |
| `mat[a,b;c,d]` | matrix (comma: column, semicolon: row) |

| `mode` | Checks |
|---|---|
| `equivalent` | mathematically equivalent (default), with `reject` and `form` |
| `exact` | exactly this representation |
| `numeric` | numeric value, with `tolerance`, `decplaces` or `sigfigs` |
| `string` / `string_ci` | text literally / ignoring case |
| `set` | list without order |
| `custom` | your own checking code in `checker` |

More options: `pool: true`, `partial-credit: true`, `field-labels`, `context`.

### JSXGraph

````{.markdown}
```jsxgraph
var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(BOARDID, {
    boundingbox: [-5, 5, 5, -5], axis: true
});
board.create('functiongraph', [Math.sin]);
```
````

As the answer to an exercise: a block with `{.jsxgraph assessment_id="board"}` and `JXG.QuartoAssessment.register(...)`, and in the exercise `#| mode: custom` and `#| response: jsxgraph:board`.

```{.yaml}
    theme:              # one name (theme: cosmo) or a list
      - cosmo
      - custom.scss
    code-fold: true
    code-tools: true
    number-sections: false
  pdf:
    toc: true
    documentclass: article
    geometry: margin=2.5cm
  docx:
    toc: true
```

### Nettsted

```{.yaml}
website:
  title: "My Site"
  navbar:
    left:
      - text: "Home"
        href: index.qmd
      - text: "External"
        href: https://example.com
    right:
      - icon: github
        href: https://github.com/your/repo
  sidebar:
    - id: my-sidebar
      style: docked        # docked | floating
      contents:
        - href: page.qmd
          text: Page Title
        - section: "Group"
          contents:
            - href: sub.qmd
              text: Sub-page
```

### Profiler

```{.yaml}
profile:
  default: [web, deutsch]
  group:
    - [web, print]          # exactly one of each group is active
    - [deutsch, english]
```

```{.bash}
quarto render --profile print,english
```

## QMD: innstillinger for kodeblokker

```{.yaml}
#| echo: false          # hide source code
#| eval: false          # don't run (show code only)
#| output: false        # hide output
#| warning: false       # hide warnings
#| include: false       # hide everything (the code still runs)
#| code-fold: true      # true | false: collapsible code block
#| code-summary: "Show the code"
#| fig-cap: "My figure"
#| fig-align: center    # left | center | right
#| label: fig-myplot    # for cross-referencing
```

### ID-er for kryssreferanser

| Type | Prefiks | Referanse |
|---|---|---|
| Figur | `fig-` | `@fig-myplot` |
| Tabell | `tbl-` | `@tbl-mydata` |
| Del | `sec-` (på overskriften) | `@sec-intro` |

```{.markdown}
Only visible in English.

::: {.content-hidden when-format="pdf"}
```

## QMD: Markdown-elementer

### Infobokser

```{.markdown}
::: {.callout-note}
::: {.callout-tip}
::: {.callout-warning}
::: {.callout-important}
::: {.callout-caution}

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Title
Hidden by default.
:::
```

### Shortcodes

```{.markdown}
{{</* include other-file.qmd */>}}   ← embed another file
{{</* pagebreak */>}}                ← force page break (PDF)
{{</* kbd Ctrl+C */>}}               ← keyboard shortcut styling
```

### Rutenett

```{.markdown}
::: {.grid}
::: {.g-col-6}
Left column (half width)
:::
::: {.g-col-6}
Right column (half width)
:::
:::
```

Kolonnebredder angis i tolvdeler: `g-col-4` = en tredjedel, `g-col-6` = halvparten, `g-col-12` = hele bredden.

## Utvidelser: syntaks i korte trekk

```{.bash}
quarto add parmsam/quizdown
quarto add Erasmus-CTM/pyodide-interaktiv
quarto add Erasmus-CTM/py-exercise
quarto add Erasmus-CTM/math-exercise      # brings jsxgraph along
```

```{.yaml}
filters:                 # mind the order
  - parmsam/quizdown
  - Erasmus-CTM/pyodide-interaktiv
  - Erasmus-CTM/py-exercise
  - jsxgraph
  - Erasmus-CTM/math-exercise
```

### quizdown

````{.markdown}
```{quizdown}
---
locale: en
---
# Question text?
1. [x] Correct answer
1. [ ] Wrong answer
```
````

### pyodide-interaktiv

````{.markdown}
```{pyodide-python}
#| autorun: false
#| read-only: false
#| code-fold: false
#| context: interactive   # interactive | output | setup
print("runs in browser")
```
````

Alle cellene på en side deler variabler. `plt.show()` starter visningen av grafer og animasjoner.

### py-exercise

````{.markdown}
```{py-exercise}
#| caption: Title
#| forbidden-keywords: for, while
def my_func(x):
    pass        # student fills this in

## TESTS ##
assert my_func(2) == 4, "Feedback on failure"
```
````

### math-exercise

````{.markdown}
```{math-exercise}
#| label: circle
#| vars: r
#| mode: equivalent
Area of a circle with r = 3: _[pi*9]
```
````

| Felt | Betydning |
|---|---|
| `_[a]` / `__[a]` / `___[a]` | smalt / middels / bredt |
| `vec[a,b,c]` | vektor |
| `mat[a,b;c,d]` | matrise (komma: kolonne, semikolon: rad) |

| `mode` | Kontrollerer |
|---|---|
| `equivalent` | matematisk ekvivalent (standard), med `reject` og `form` |
| `exact` | nøyaktig denne skrivemåten |
| `numeric` | tallverdi, med `tolerance`, `decplaces` eller `sigfigs` |
| `string` / `string_ci` | tekst bokstavelig / uten hensyn til store og små bokstaver |
| `set` | liste uten rekkefølge |
| `custom` | din egen kontrollkode i `checker` |

Flere innstillinger: `pool: true`, `partial-credit: true`, `field-labels`, `context`.

### JSXGraph

````{.markdown}
```jsxgraph
var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(BOARDID, {
    boundingbox: [-5, 5, 5, -5], axis: true
});
board.create('functiongraph', [Math.sin]);
```
````

Som svar på en oppgave: en blokk med `{.jsxgraph assessment_id="board"}` og `JXG.QuartoAssessment.register(...)`, og i oppgaven `#| mode: custom` og `#| response: jsxgraph:board`.

| `.d-flex` | Flexbox-beholder |

| `.justify-content-center` | Midtstille flex-elementer |

## YAML: inställningar i `_quarto.yml`

```{.yaml}
project:
```

```{.yaml}
  warning: false      # hide warnings

  freeze: auto        # auto | true | false
```
